نقتضي (form VIII)
# نَقْتَضِي (naqtaḍī) /naq.ta.dˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# نَقْتَضِيَ (naqtaḍiya) /naq.ta.dˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
